# folded-pocket / sheet deck
  1x cut closed role=central-cutout owner=pocket stage=1
  4x cut closed role=corner-relief owner=pocket stage=1
  12x cut open role=exterior owner=- stage=4
  8x cut open role=perimeter-corner-clearance owner=- stage=4
  8x cut open role=perimeter-flange-chamfer owner=- stage=4
  8x cut open role=perimeter-side owner=- stage=4
  4x score open role=flange-fold owner=pocket stage=0
  4x score open role=perimeter-deck-fold owner=- stage=0
  4x score open role=perimeter-flange-fold owner=- stage=0
  4x score open role=top-fold owner=pocket stage=0

# joist-perimeter / sheet deck
  1x cut closed role=central-cutout owner=pocket stage=1
  4x cut closed role=corner-relief owner=pocket stage=1
  2x cut closed role=joist-lock-slot owner=- stage=1
  12x cut open role=exterior owner=- stage=4
  4x cut open role=joist-end owner=- stage=4
  4x cut open role=joist-lock-tab owner=- stage=4
  4x cut open role=joist-terminal owner=- stage=4
  4x score open role=flange-fold owner=pocket stage=0
  2x score open role=joist-fold-1 owner=- stage=0
  2x score open role=joist-fold-2 owner=- stage=0
  2x score open role=joist-fold-3 owner=- stage=0
  2x score open role=joist-fold-4 owner=- stage=0
  2x score open role=joist-fold-5 owner=- stage=0
  4x score open role=top-fold owner=pocket stage=0

# tray-and-riser / sheet deck
  1x cut closed role=central-cutout owner=pocket stage=1
  4x cut closed role=corner-relief owner=pocket stage=1
  1x cut closed role=tray-opening owner=riser stage=2
  12x cut open role=exterior owner=- stage=4
  8x cut open role=perimeter-corner-clearance owner=- stage=4
  8x cut open role=perimeter-flange-chamfer owner=- stage=4
  8x cut open role=perimeter-side owner=- stage=4
  4x score open role=flange-fold owner=pocket stage=0
  4x score open role=perimeter-deck-fold owner=- stage=0
  4x score open role=perimeter-flange-fold owner=- stage=0
  4x score open role=top-fold owner=pocket stage=0

# tray-and-riser / sheet parts
  4x cut closed role=riser-lock-slot owner=riser stage=1
  12x cut open role=riser-bottom-flange owner=riser stage=2
  8x cut open role=riser-lock-edge owner=riser stage=2
  12x cut open role=riser-lock-tab owner=riser stage=2
  4x cut open role=riser-wall-edge owner=riser stage=2
  12x cut open role=tray-flange-edge owner=riser stage=2
  8x cut open role=tray-wall-edge owner=riser stage=2
  4x score open role=riser-bottom-flange-fold owner=riser stage=0
  4x score open role=riser-lock-tab-fold owner=riser stage=0
  4x score open role=riser-top-fold owner=riser stage=0
  4x score open role=tray-flange-fold owner=riser stage=0
  4x score open role=tray-wall-fold owner=riser stage=0

# router-openings / sheet deck
  1x cut closed role=router-deck-perimeter owner=- stage=4
  1x cut closed role=router-opening owner=pocket stage=1

# part-openings / sheet parts
  2x cut closed role=central-cutout owner=pocket stage=1
  4x cut closed role=corner-relief owner=pocket stage=1
  12x cut open role=riser-bottom-flange owner=riser stage=2
  12x cut open role=riser-corner-tab owner=riser stage=2
